title.zh: 驻波 · 原地起伏的波
title.en: Standing Waves · The Wave That Stays in Place

desc.zh: 两列相同的波迎面相遇，波形不再前进，只在原地起伏：有些点永远不动（波节），有些点振幅翻倍（波腹）。两端固定的弦只放行 L=nλ/2 的台阶，驱动频率踩中台阶，就会共振。
desc.en: Two identical waves travelling towards each other lock into a pattern that no longer travels — it only rises and falls in place: some points never move (nodes), others swing with double amplitude (antinodes). A string fixed at both ends admits only L = nλ/2, and driving it on one of those steps is resonance.
